text: The purpose of this report is to make changes to The Eglinton Way Business Improvement Area Boards of Management, in accordance with the requirements of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 19, Business Improvement Areas. The Eglinton Way Business Improvement Area falls within two Community Council boundaries.
